source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.5, printed pages 100-107.

blocks.text: Carbohydrates qudrati taur par milne wale organic compounds hain. Lafz “carbohydrate” ka lafzi matlab hai “hydrated carbon” (pani wala carbon). Carbohydrates photosynthesis ki pehli (primary) products ke taur par bante hain. Photosynthesis mein jab CO₂ reduce hoti hai (us mein hydrogen judti hai), to banne wale carbohydrate molecule mein carbon, hydrogen aur oxygen 1:2:1 ki molar ratio (nisbat) mein hote hain. Is liye in ka general formula Cₙ(H₂O)ₙ hai, jahan ‘n’ carbon atoms ki tadaad hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab formula C(H₂O)ₙ likhti hai. Is mein sirf aik carbon hai, is liye ‘n’ carbon atoms ki tadaad nahi ho sakta. Sahi general formula Cₙ(H₂O)ₙ hai (kabhi Cₓ(H₂O)ᵧ bhi likhte hain), jahan n carbon atoms ki tadaad hai; maslan glucose C₆H₁₂O₆ = C₆(H₂O)₆. Empirical formula (sab se saada nisbat) CH₂O hai.
